purpose: Documentation-only provenance map for legacy validation behaviour that is not directly established by the bundled Innmålingsinstruks PDFs. IDs are research identifiers, not executable Validator 2.0 rule IDs.

behaviours.name: Pressure/gravity classifier heuristics
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: the PDFs distinguish pressure and gravity applicability, but do not define this classifier
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced the classifier with the active field validator
The adjacent GMI analysis was based on 51 Færder Kommune files
behaviours.likelyIntent: Infer hydraulic class from heterogeneous legacy deliveries so conditional field rules could run without a canonical class field.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve the need for classification, but replace implicit heuristics with an explainable, configurable classifier and an unknown result.
behaviours.notes: Branches inspect Tema substrings, Nett_type, material, SDR and Trykklasse. Git history does not establish that every branch is domain-approved.

behaviours.name: Ringstivhet required for all lines classified as gravity
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: the source limits the requirement to self-fall plastic pipe
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced the gravity condition
No commit rationale was found for omitting the material condition
behaviours.likelyIntent: Use hydraulic class as a practical proxy for the source condition.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not copy unchanged; model hydraulic class and material separately, with any broader practice rule exposed as an override.
behaviours.notes: Current behaviour is broader than the PDF-backed condition.

behaviours.name: SDR required for lines classified as pressure
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: source applicability is pressure pipe; the classifier is not sourced
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced the condition
2d2a2685 explicitly described an SDR validation fix
behaviours.likelyIntent: Operationalize the source pressure-pipe condition when deliveries lack an explicit canonical class.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve the source-backed requirement after hydraulic classification is made explicit and auditable.
behaviours.notes: Presence of SDR is also used as evidence that a line is pressure, creating circular classification risk.

behaviours.name: Trykklasse applicable only to lines classified as pressure
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: source says optional for pressure pipe; legacy non-applicable values become unexpected
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced both the condition and unexpected-value path
No domain approval was found in history
behaviours.likelyIntent: Restrict review of pressure class to hydraulically relevant lines.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve optional pressure applicability; decide separately whether values on other objects are prohibited, diagnostic, or ignored.
behaviours.notes: Trykklasse presence is also classifier evidence.

behaviours.name: Bredde applicability subset KUM/LOK/SAN/SLS/SLU
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as this exact object-code subset
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 introduced the subset
GMI_ANALYSIS.md reports Bredde prevalence by S_FCODE in 51 Færder files
behaviours.likelyIntent: Limit missing-value warnings to object types where Bredde was commonly populated in real deliveries.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Candidate municipality/practice profile rule; verify the object list and meaning of Bredde before migration.
behaviours.notes: Observed values also existed for excluded codes, including STR, so prevalence alone does not prove the chosen boundary.

behaviours.name: Byggemetode applicability subset KUM/LOK/SAN/SLS/SLU
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as this exact object-code subset
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 introduced the subset
GMI_ANALYSIS.md reports Byggemetode prevalence by S_FCODE in 51 Færder files
behaviours.likelyIntent: Turn observed municipal delivery patterns into targeted completeness warnings.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Candidate municipality/practice profile rule; retain only after confirming the object taxonomy and whether the rule is required or advisory.
behaviours.notes: Other object codes also had values in the analyzed corpus.

behaviours.name: Kumform applicability subset KUM/SAN/SLS/SLU
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as this exact object-code subset
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 changed Kumform from always to conditional and introduced the subset
GMI_ANALYSIS.md contains the corresponding prevalence analysis
behaviours.likelyIntent: Avoid requiring Kumform on point types where practical deliveries did not consistently use it.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Needs domain-owner confirmation; likely a profile rule rather than a universal standard rule.
behaviours.notes: The exact exclusion of LOK and other populated codes is unexplained.

behaviours.name: Kjegle applicability subset KUM/SAN/SLS/SLU
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as this exact object-code subset
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 changed Kjegle from always to conditional and introduced the subset
GMI_ANALYSIS.md contains Kjegle prevalence by S_FCODE
behaviours.likelyIntent: Use observed point-type conventions to focus completeness warnings.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Needs domain-owner confirmation and should be profile-configurable if retained.
behaviours.notes: History records the code change but not a domain rationale.

behaviours.name: Type applicability subset FORAKONSTR/DIV/GRØKONSTR
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as this exact subset or spelling
gitEvidence: 28e8246 analyzed Type in 51 Færder GMI files
type_analysis.json classified FORAKONSTR and GRØKONSTR as requireType and DIV as shouldHaveType
2d2a2685 copied those three codes into validation
behaviours.likelyIntent: Encode a real-delivery pattern identified by a dedicated analysis immediately before the validation change.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Valuable profile/practice candidate, but preserve the distinction between required and recommended and reconcile FORAKONSTR with source terminology.
behaviours.notes: Legacy execution treats DIV as the same applicability class even though the analysis called it should-have.

behaviours.name: Gravity-line incline classification and fixed/variable thresholds
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND in the bundled PDFs
gitEvidence: 6ac4aad introduced the incline analysis
Archived 2026-01-17 product notes explicitly request a fixed 10 per mille default for SP/OV/AF gravity lines and a variable alternative
behaviours.likelyIntent: Provide an experience-based hydraulic quality screen requested for practical delivery review.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve as an optional/profile rule with cited external policy, explicit hydraulic classification, and configurable thresholds.
behaviours.notes: The surviving repository does not identify a precise external standard edition for the thresholds.

behaviours.name: Topplokk pairing for KUM/SLU/SLS/SAN with proximity tolerance
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: source concepts support installations and lids, but not this list or tolerance algorithm
gitEvidence: 7842115 introduced a one-metre pairing check
8729ed7 changed it to a diameter-aware tolerance bounded from 0.3 to 5 metres
Archived product notes request both missing and orphan lid checks
behaviours.likelyIntent: Detect incomplete or spatially implausible structure/lid pairs in contractor deliveries.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve intent but redesign as explainable geometry/pairing rules after object list and tolerance policy are confirmed.
behaviours.notes: Distance is a heuristic substitute for an explicit relationship key.

behaviours.name: Minimum overcover default of 1.6 metres
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND in the bundled PDFs
gitEvidence: 5cc6b18 introduced a two-metre default following archived product notes
34bc889 changed the configurable default to 1.6 metres without a surviving domain rationale
behaviours.likelyIntent: Screen lines against a practical minimum-cover policy while allowing project adjustment.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Keep only as a configurable municipality/project profile rule; do not hard-code 1.6 metres as universal.
behaviours.notes: The historical change from 2.0 to 1.6 metres is unresolved.

behaviours.name: Exact, alias, then case-insensitive field resolution
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced FIELD_ALIASES and the fallback resolver
The commit describes integration with analyzed GMI data but does not document each alias
behaviours.likelyIntent: Accept known naming variation in legacy exports without modifying source files.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve the adapter concept using explicit, format-scoped aliases with provenance; avoid unconstrained semantic aliases.
behaviours.notes: Case-insensitive fallback is broad and can become ambiguous when two source fields differ only by case.

behaviours.name: SOSI object-name to GMI-like S_FCODE inference
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as an authoritative crosswalk
gitEvidence: 5a1744f3 explicitly introduced GMI-compatible S_FCODE mapping for SOSI
Archived SOSI/KOF notes describe GMI as primary and normalization as reuse for validators and renderers
behaviours.likelyIntent: Reuse GMI styling, filters, and some analysis across SOSI input.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Retain only as a declared adapter mapping; inferred codes must not silently prove source-rule compliance.
behaviours.notes: Some point mappings produce line-like or non-source codes, demonstrating that the crosswalk is operational rather than canonical.

behaviours.name: SOSI fallback codes and polygon-as-line normalization
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: 5a1744f3 added fallback to object name or DIV and normalized polygons as lines for simple visualization
behaviours.likelyIntent: Keep unsupported or unfamiliar SOSI objects visible and compatible with a two-geometry application model.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve display fallback separately from validation identity; retain native geometry and an unknown/unmapped code state.
behaviours.notes: DIV and object-name fallbacks must not be treated as authoritative Tema values.

behaviours.name: KOF code/name/section fallback to S_FCODE
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as an authoritative GMI mapping
gitEvidence: 5a1744f3 initially copied the KOF operation code
56468799 evolved the fallback to code, name, section, or synthetic KOF labels for variable dialects
behaviours.likelyIntent: Give primitive and inconsistent KOF records a stable display/grouping field.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Keep as format metadata only; do not validate inferred S_FCODE as if it were a delivered GMI Tema without a verified crosswalk.
behaviours.notes: Archived notes explicitly characterize KOF as attribute-limited.

behaviours.name: GMI parser coercion of numeric-looking attribute text
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: d70ec1b imported this behaviour with the original legacy parser
behaviours.likelyIntent: Make measurements immediately usable as JavaScript numbers.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve typed parsing only where the canonical field type is numeric; retain lexical code forms and original values for traceability.
behaviours.notes: Universal coercion can erase leading zeroes and lexical distinctions in code fields.

behaviours.name: Field validation disabled for KOF layers
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: SOSI/KOF product notes state that KOF has very limited attributes
UI guards intentionally prevent the GMI field validator from running on KOF
behaviours.likelyIntent: Avoid a flood of misleading missing-field results on a format incapable of carrying the same attributes.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve the capability distinction, but express it in validator/format capabilities rather than only UI guards.
behaviours.notes: KOF can still support geometry or other format-appropriate diagnostics.

behaviours.name: Field-level status based on prevalence rather than issue severity
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced error when all required objects are missing and warning when only some fail
No domain severity rationale was found
behaviours.likelyIntent: Prioritize completely absent required columns above partial data-quality problems in the summary UI.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve completion metrics, but separate prevalence, rule severity, and run status.
behaviours.notes: The same semantic violation changes status solely according to how many objects exhibit it.

behaviours.name: Common-field aggregation with separate point and line detail tabs
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: d70ec1b split rule files to avoid point/line name collisions
7cbee015 later aggregated logical fields for a shared validation view
behaviours.likelyIntent: Reduce duplicate rows while retaining geometry-specific detail.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Redesign around one selected layer per run and canonical source field identity; aggregation belongs in reporting, not rule identity.
behaviours.notes: This architecture helped perpetuate suffix-based logical keys.

behaviours.name: Whitespace trimming before allowed-value comparison
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as a general normalization rule
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 added trimming while fixing SDR comparison
behaviours.likelyIntent: Tolerate harmless export formatting differences.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Retain only as explicit per-field or per-format normalization with the original value shown.
behaviours.notes: Whether surrounding whitespace is harmless depends on the field contract.

behaviours.name: Synthetic array-index IDs for locating failing features
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 added failingIds
Archived 2026-01-17 product notes request viewing and highlighting affected objects
behaviours.likelyIntent: Connect validation results to map inspection even when source objects lack a stable ID.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve navigation intent but use layer-scoped stable feature identities and distinguish source IDs from internal IDs.
behaviours.notes: Raw array indices are unstable across filtering, reparsing, and multiple layers.

behaviours.name: Treating Z equal to zero as missing or invalid
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: finite height presence is supported; zero-specific invalidity is not found
gitEvidence: 5a1744f3 normalized missing/non-finite Z to zero
56468799 added Z validation that rejects zero
Archived product notes require Z values but do not say that zero is invalid
behaviours.likelyIntent: Use zero as a technical sentinel for height lost during normalization, then detect the sentinel later.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve missing/non-finite Z validation; stop collapsing absence to zero and make any zero-specific policy configurable pending domain decision.
behaviours.notes: A legitimate elevation of zero cannot be distinguished after current normalization.

behaviours.name: Defaulting every unrecognized line to gravity
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced the unconditional gravity fallback
No commit or documentation explains why unknown is impossible
behaviours.likelyIntent: Keep binary conditional validation deterministic and bias toward the more common self-fall case.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry the fallback; represent unknown classification and report which evidence was absent or conflicting.
behaviours.notes: This can incorrectly require Ringstivhet and suppress pressure-field rules.

behaviours.name: Logical _punkt/_led keys used as source lookup names without complete aliases
behaviours.sourceStatus: CONTRADICTS canonical source-field identity
gitEvidence: d70ec1b imported suffixed keys from a previous database and split schemas to avoid name collisions
No later commit added aliases for every suffixed logical key
behaviours.likelyIntent: Disambiguate point and line rule records, not rename delivered attributes.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry the lookup behaviour; separate canonical source field from geometry applicability and retain explicit legacy-key aliases only for documentation migration.
behaviours.notes: Live observations on 2026-08-21 show populated NOBB-VAVVS-nr and InnvendigUtvendig line fields reported as absent through their _led logical keys.

behaviours.name: Semantically risky or inert field aliases
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced all active aliases without per-alias provenance
Dato aliases are inert because there is no matching active Dato field key
behaviours.likelyIntent: Rapidly accommodate field names seen in analyzed exports.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not copy wholesale; verify aliases individually and reject ambiguous collisions.
behaviours.notes: Examples include Nøyaktighet mapped to H_MÅLEMETODE and Bredde mapped to DIMENSJON/DIM across point and line semantics.

behaviours.name: Universal parseFloat equivalence for allowed values
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as a universal rule
gitEvidence: 2d2a2685 added numeric equivalence specifically to fix SDR values such as 11 versus 11.0
behaviours.likelyIntent: Repair a real lexical-versus-numeric mismatch for SDR after values were represented as numbers.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Preserve the SDR compatibility intent only through field-typed normalization; do not use prefix-tolerant parseFloat for every code set.
behaviours.notes: parseFloat can accept numeric prefixes with trailing junk and erase leading-zero distinctions.

behaviours.name: Comparator comment and detail UI disagree with executable comparison
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: The comparator comment says case-insensitive, but no lowercasing exists
The detail modal uses exact String comparison and does not mirror trim/numeric equivalence
behaviours.likelyIntent: The comment and UI were intended to explain the same validation result but drifted from the evaluator.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry; produce issues once in the evaluator and render those issues without reimplementing comparison logic.
behaviours.notes: A value may be accepted by the engine yet displayed as invalid.

behaviours.name: Required-state execution gaps and green optional invalid values
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND
gitEvidence: d70ec1b imported always/conditional/optional/optionalAlt/geminiOnly/polygonExcluded metadata
7cbee015 only assigned status consequences for always and conditional
behaviours.likelyIntent: Incrementally support the most important states while retaining legacy metadata for display.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry execution semantics; define presence, applicability, value validity, and severity independently for every migrated rule.
behaviours.notes: Conditional invalid values and optional invalid values can leave overall status OK; non-always states are often collapsed in UI wording.

behaviours.name: Duplicate dormant and active rule registries drift independently
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: d70ec1b introduced the first validator and split JSON registries
7cbee015 introduced a separate active validator over fields.json
2d2a2685 changed active conditional metadata without equivalent dormant-registry changes
behaviours.likelyIntent: Replace or supplement the initial validator without completing a registry migration.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry duplicated authority; keep one canonical rule inventory and explicit adapters for legacy metadata.
behaviours.notes: Dormant definitions are provenance evidence, not reliable current policy.

behaviours.name: AnleggsID marked conditional without an executable predicate
behaviours.sourceStatus: PARTIAL: the source describes conditional semantics, but legacy execution does not encode them
gitEvidence: d70ec1b imported conditional metadata from the previous database
No active predicate for AnleggsID was added in later history
behaviours.likelyIntent: Retain a known conditional requirement before the condition was implemented.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not infer a condition; keep deferred until the source condition and delivery workflow are resolved.
behaviours.notes: The generic conditional status logic is not a substitute for object-level applicability.

behaviours.name: Whitespace-only text can count as present
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT A SOURCE RULE
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 defined presence as non-null and not the exact empty string
No later commit addressed whitespace-only values
behaviours.likelyIntent: Use a simple type-agnostic presence test.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Do not carry blindly; define empty semantics by canonical type while preserving zero and false where valid.
behaviours.notes: Allowed-value fields may still fail comparison, but free-text required fields can pass with only whitespace.

behaviours.name: Supplied values on non-applicable objects reported as unexpected warnings
behaviours.sourceStatus: NOT FOUND as a general forbidden-value rule
gitEvidence: 7cbee015 introduced unexpected-value counting
2d2a2685 added such objects to failingIds with a comment explicitly saying 'maybe' and 'for now'
behaviours.likelyIntent: Expose potentially misplaced data for manual review rather than silently ignore it.
behaviours.v2Disposition: Retain, at most, as an optional diagnostic until each field has an explicit forbidden-value policy.
behaviours.notes: Non-applicable does not logically imply forbidden; the historical comment confirms provisional intent.
